summary: Completed backend+frontend regression for EN/SK localization, auth flows, Google session handling (simulated), mock AI output labels, pipeline persistence, and build/typecheck. Backend pytest passed 10/10. Frontend core flows passed (language persistence, EN errors, Google redirect contract, invalid session rejection, save/refine/pipeline, provider modal translation, CSV/CRM actions).

minor.issue: Code review: getDb() uses fallback DB_NAME default (`process.env.DB_NAME || "slovak_b2b"`) instead of strict env-only fail-fast policy.

integration_issues.flow: Responsive full-matrix automation (discover/audit/guide/pipeline/modals across all widths)
integration_issues.issue: Automation hit repeated selector visibility/timeouts after viewport switching; login responsive checks passed, but full tab-matrix could not be fully completed in final pass.

action_items: Optional hardening: remove DB_NAME fallback default to enforce env-only startup contract.
Retest responsive tab/mode matrix manually or with stabilized viewport-switch automation due repeated selector timeout in final responsive sweep.
critical_code_review_comments: server.ts remains very large (~2100 lines); split auth/leads/AI/email routes into focused modules for maintainability and safer regression scope.
DB_NAME fallback default should be removed to align with strict environment-variable fail-fast requirement.
No duplicate data-testid values detected in static scan; interactive coverage is generally good.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (core requested flows passed; one responsive matrix sweep incomplete)

seed_data_creation: Temporary users with prefix iter3_* plus one simulated Google session user/document were created for tests and then cleaned from MongoDB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: language switch persists across reload/sign-in/sign-out and updates html lang; EN wrong-password message; Google button redirects to auth.emergentagent.com with current-origin redirect; invalid/missing google session rejected; simulated Mongo session_token accepted by /api/auth/me; /api/leads/search,/api/audit/company,/api/leads/refine-pitch EN/SK mock outputs include isMock at response+prospect level; pipeline coldOutreach.language only changes after regenerate+save (not by UI selection alone); provider modal translated in EN with EN validation message; CSV download and CRM copy actions work; mail action is mailto. Limitation: no live AI key, so provider prompt-contract behavior validated only in MOCKED fallback mode.
rca of the issue: Unresolved test gap RCA: repeated Playwright timeout on desktop tab selector during rapid viewport switching likely due transient render/layout timing in responsive automation, not a confirmed product bug. Reproduction: iterate 320→768→1024→1440 while toggling tabs quickly. Mitigation: add explicit post-resize wait for stable nav visibility and branch selectors by visible breakpoint before clicks.
